topic: How does Indian Railways keep the whole country moving?

hook.text: How does Indian Railways keep the whole country moving?

lines.say: Indian Railways carried seven hundred and forty one crore passengers in twenty twenty-five, twenty-six.
That's about two crore people every single day!
Vande Bharat ridership grew thirty four percent, I'm told. Splendid.
But three point three nine crore people could not travel on waitlisted tickets.
lines.cap: 3.39 CRORE couldn't travel on waitlisted tickets

lines.say: What's your worst train ticket story? Tell us in the comments!
